decision.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): Indonesian “adonan cair” appropriately conveys batter. Malaysian “adunan” is a broader flour mixture term; authoritative Malaysian sources define “batter” as “bater,” specifically an “adunan cair.” The card therefore understates the Malaysian specificity. The forms are related cognates, not a false-friend contrast; the issue is specificity, not opposite meaning. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
